answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments anchor each agent to a sequential delay trellis, binding history under extractable collision-resistant assumptions. Any clone must replay this trellis from genesis or forge a signal indistinguishable from honest work, whose success probability decays exponentially. Verifiable delay thus forces identity cloning infeasible even for unbounded adversaries, since the trellis anchor transforms spoofing into inverting a random oracle.
